workbuddy-history-sharing.title: Share selected observations
workbuddy-history-sharing.selection_limi: Share up to 8 observations at a time. Deselect some entries first.
workbuddy-history-sharing.selection_inva: This selection changed or includes entries that cannot be shared. Select supported text from a finished observation load again.
workbuddy-history-sharing.scope: Visible to project members who can read the target task. Revoking the original cloud connection does not remove this explicitly shared copy.
workbuddy-history-sharing.search_invalid: The search is invalid. Shorten and check the input.
workbuddy-history-sharing.choose_task: Choose a task you can currently access
workbuddy-history-sharing.reading_tasks: Reading tasks you can currently access…
workbuddy-history-sharing.tasks_failed: The current task list could not be verified. Read it again before selecting a task.
workbuddy-history-sharing.tasks_empty: No tasks match the current filters.
workbuddy-history-sharing.coverage: Only the explicitly selected text is shared. Coverage of the original observation remains unverified.
workbuddy-history-sharing.confirm_title: Confirm sharing to the project task
workbuddy-history-sharing.confirm_scope: I reviewed the selected text and visibility, and agree to share it to the target task as my own discussion message.
workbuddy-history-sharing.shared: Shared to the target task as your discussion message. No model was called, execution started or acceptance decision made.
workbuddy-history-sharing.pending_hint: Keep the original request and operation ID, and check its receipt before continuing. Later changes to the private observation do not prove that sharing never happened.
workbuddy-history-sharing.recovery_block: The locally saved original operation could not be verified. New sharing is paused; keep the original record for reconciliation and recovery.
workbuddy-history-sharing.denied: You cannot currently read or share the selected observation. This preview text was cleared; the original operation record is retained.
workbuddy-history-sharing.changed: The target task, selected observation or preview basis changed. Read and preview again; keep checking any original operation whose result is uncertain.
workbuddy-history-sharing.preview_failed: The sharing preview could not be read or verified. Keep the selection, check the current task and original observation, then preview again.
workbuddy-history-sharing.share_failed: Sharing could not be confirmed. Check the current task and selected observation.
